closure_status.what_is_reproduced: Under three declared inputs (H_3 Shephard-Todd D=18 + icosahedral RG step b=phi + symmetry-adapted bookkeeping), the bookkeeping returns K_perp/K_parallel = phi^(-18). This is a Tier 3 conditional physical-link calculation, not a derivation of the RG rule.
closure_status.what_remains_open: First-principles derivation of the 'd_n * log(phi) per fundamental invariant' anomalous-dimension bookkeeping from explicit one-loop integration of the LRT free energy on the AKN lattice. The physical link remains Tier 3 pending O.15(b) and bundles with O.5 QLQCD-1L (same non-perturbative-lattice machinery).
closure_status.scope_caveat: The protocol IMPLEMENTS the dimensional-RG bookkeeping; it does not DERIVE the bookkeeping from a first-principles loop calculation. Two inputs are taken as principled but not derived in-protocol: (a) the icosahedral RG step b=phi, (b) the per-invariant contribution d_n * log(phi).
